title: The Living Soul as the Second Field, Tilled from Above
description: The purified Living Soul as a second ploughed-field set within the entire Zone of the upper place, with the two great heavenly luminaries (sun and moon as the conjoined pair of Divine Truth illuminating and reflecting) doing farmer's work upon her — assimilating her motion to the divine likeness and drawing her upward to the Height. A second tillage in heavenly soil for elevation, after the first sorting in the natural earth.
